ModMetaData.name: Fairycore - Spirit Wings
ModMetaData.author: Faeris
ModMetaData.description:
Fairycore - Spirit Wings adds Venenum and Pixie genes in its Wings category, along with twenty wing genes and four fairy races.
When Venenum awakens, a pair of glowing fairy wings unfolds and carries its bearer into the air, for as long as her mind can bear the heat.
FAIRY RACES
- Monarch fairy: Venenum and the fairy look. 0.1% of pawns in every faction. - Court fairy: lesser Venenum (flight and some evasion) and the fairy look. 0.5%. - Lesser fairy: wings purely for looks. 1%. - Pixie: Pixie and the fairy look, the size of a child for life. 0.75%. - These presets are female, inheritable, and born with one wing design at random, unless male fairies are allowed in the mod settings. - Babies never fly or show wings; fairy children fly with child-sized wings.
PIXIE
- 5 complexity, 0 metabolism. Needs a wing gene; without one, the gene stays dormant. - The size of a child for life, while keeping her own body, real age and adult work; adult pixies wear adult clothes. - Flight at about 3x movement speed, with 95% evasion like Venenum. Fire and area attacks pass her by, psychic sensitivity +200%, and psyfocus builds while she flies. No heat, delirium or Momentum. - Flying makes her hungry and tired 25% faster. Right-click the button to let her fly by herself: when drafted, or always (landing when food or rest runs low, if you choose). - Flutter Dash, as with Venenum. - Wands or pistols only. A melee blow that lands in flight knocks her back. - A Pixie xenogerm puts its bearer to sleep for a day inside a glowing orb, which is hard to hit and can be carried to bed. - Pixie children come from a 15-day pregnancy as an orb and hatch a day later as children, already walking. - A child of two fairy races is born as one of them. - A rare quest brings one Pixie fleeing slavers.
WINGS
- 20 wing genes: 10 insect (beetle, cicada, damselfly, dragonfly, firefly, grasshopper, lacewing, moth, praying mantis, wasp) and 10 butterfly (birdwing, blue morpho, common blue, glasswing, luna moth, monarch, paper kite, peacock, red admiral, swallowtail). - 0 complexity, 0 metabolism, +2 beauty. A pawn has one design at a time. - On their own, the wings are always visible and flap gently, but cannot fly. - With Venenum or lesser Venenum, they stay hidden until it awakens, then fade in with a soft glow. - 8-frame flight animations for every facing and vanilla body type.
VENENUM
- 10 complexity, +20 metabolism. Needs a wing gene. - Awakens only in women. A man keeps only the metabolism, unless "Allow male fairies" is on in the mod settings (Dev Mode). - Always: fire immunity, and Ageless without archites. - Switch it on by hand, or right-click the button to let it switch on by itself: when drafted, or always (it lands at the heat limit and flies again once the heat is gone). NPCs switch it on in a fight. Asleep, she lands and the wings fold, unless the wings were switched on by hand with auto mode off. - Flight: about 2.8x movement speed over any terrain. - Evasion: 95% of shots and melee blows miss. Turret shots, lasers and beams still hit. - Psychic sensitivity: +200%. Psyfocus builds while it is on, and switching it on restores 30% (at most once an hour). - Momentum: the next melee hit gains +500% damage and armor penetration, stuns, and knocks the target back, with no attack cooldown afterward. Restored by Flutter Dash or when no enemy is within 5 tiles. - Attack speed rises with neural heat, from +300% at 120% heat to +500% at 200%. - Flutter Dash: a fast 24.9-tile leap through the air. Costs 10% psyfocus (without Royalty, a little food and rest). - With Royalty, a carrier without a psylink gains level 1. - A psychic shock in flight brings her down to the ground, unless Last Stand blocks it.
NEURAL HEAT
- Heat uses a percentage of the pawn's limit, so a larger heat limit does not extend flight time. - Venenum reaches the heat limit in about 2 minutes. There, you choose: push on, or let it burn out until heat falls below 50%. Pushing on also switches the neural heat meter to allow going over the limit. NPCs always burn out. - Pushing on is her choice, and her mood decides. Past the limit, heat reaches 200% in about 3 more minutes, causing psychic shock. - With Royalty, Venenum uses normal psychic heat. Without Royalty, it uses its own heat bar.
PSYCHIC DELIRIUM
Pushing Venenum past its limit brings on Psychic Delirium, ranging from 0-100%.
- It gets worse with repeated use and rises much faster past the heat limit. - Psychic sensitivity rises from +35% up to +500%, and consciousness rises by as much as the delirium itself (+75% at 75%). - No random breaks of its own: it raises the mental break threshold by half its severity. When a break comes, it is the delirium's: confusion or vomiting, panic (20%), catatonia (40%), berserk rage or Alzheimer's (60%). While drafted, only berserk rage. - It teaches Indomitable (at any severity), Brandish (25%), Avalanche (50%) and Fairy's Gate (75%). - Indomitable: she holds on through pain and stuns. Cast against a psychic shock, it becomes Last Stand and blocks it. - Brandish: +1000% melee attack speed for a moment. - Avalanche: one sweeping hit with +1000% damage and armor penetration through every enemy in the five tiles ahead. - Indomitable, Brandish and Avalanche cast themselves by default (right-click to change). - NPC fairies never push past the heat limit and never open the Gate. - Fairy's Gate: a deliberate psychic blast at half the strength of the final explosion. Using it always kills the fairy and can kill nearby pawns. - 90%: Venenum locks on and the fairy enters a frenzy. Pawns incapable of violence fall into confusion instead. - 100%: an antigrain-strength psychic explosion, made even stronger by psychic sensitivity. Nothing remains to resurrect. - Recreation and conversation reduce it very slowly, until 90%.
LESSER VENENUM
- 5 complexity, 0 metabolism, any gender. Needs a wing gene. - Flight at about 1.4x movement speed, with 50% evasion in the air (half of Venenum's), ranged and melee alike. Turret shots, lasers and beams still hit. No heat, delirium, abilities, fire immunity or Ageless. - Wing stamina: a full bar is 2 minutes of flight. Sleep refills it; awake, it comes back slowly. - When the bar runs out, you choose: land, or keep flying on rest and food, which drain fast. On "always", she lands and flies again once the bar is full. At 50% rest or food, she falls from the sky and gets hurt, and cannot fly again until both are above 50%. NPCs land.
ENEMY SEARCH
- A free button for drafted carriers of Venenum or lesser Venenum: she seeks out enemies and fights them, in melee or with a ranged weapon. - With Search and Destroy active, the button uses that mod's own setting.
THE FAIRY'S VOICE
The fairy can speak during important stages of Venenum and Psychic Delirium.
- There are ten possible lines for each moment. - Lines can reference their lover, parents, children, siblings, friends, best friend, colony, time spent there, or personal memories. - A line only appears when that person or memory actually exists. - Fairy's Gate: the fairy is warned that using it means certain death with nothing left to resurrect. Her mood, and the people she loves, decide whether she accepts. - A fairy who refuses won't be asked again for 60 days, and won't call on Venenum until her heat has cooled and her delirium has passed. A willing fairy says her last words before opening the Gate. - At 90% Delirium, Scarborough Fair begins to play. - At 100% Delirium, the game pauses for one final broken farewell.
REQUIREMENTS
- Biotech: required. - Royalty: optional; adds psylink support and uses psychic heat. - Harmony: required.
COMPATIBILITY
- CE compatible - Safe to add and remove.
CREDITS
- Faeris
